entities.summary: Pierre Alexandre Joseph Allent was a French général de division. He served in the Chamber of Deputies under the Bourbon Restoration and in the Chamber of Peers under the July Monarchy. He was a knight of the Order of Saint Louis and a commander of the Legion of Honour.
